precondition: unique structural equality and manual Hash implementation cover the complete MathMatrixElem carrier, including value changes made with the corresponding explicit-presence bit unchanged

variants.transform: omit row/cell order from equality or hash
omit the Align2D value from equality or hash while align presence remains true on both operands
omit hline/vline axis identity or offset order
omit or conflate the relative or absolute component of row_gap or column_gap while the matching presence bit remains true on both operands
omit one of the five MathMatrixExplicit bits, using column_gap as the canonical physical patch

variant_killers.M17c-align: same-presence Left versus Right align pair must differ in both Eq and Hash
variant_killers.M17h-gap-component: for each of row-gap and column-gap, same-presence pairs independently vary 100% versus 150% with fixed 1em, then 1em versus 2em with fixed 100%; every pair must differ in Eq and Hash

validity: Every variant must be killed by its own pairwise equality and hash witness. M17c and M17h cannot take credit from explicit-presence changes or from another carrier field.
